say:1:1710846001:1.text: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?
say:1:1710846001:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀——累坏我啦！好久没活动筋骨，一上来就搞这么大的...
say:1:1710846001:1.male: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?
say:1:1710846001:1.female: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?

say:2:1710846002:1.text: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.
say:2:1710846002:1.source_cn: 你看着他这副模样，一时间竟有些恍惚。
say:2:1710846002:1.male: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.
say:2:1710846002:1.female: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.

say:3:1710846003:1.text: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.
say:3:1710846003:1.source_cn: 喂，梅林。活儿干完了。深渊裂隙封了，迪尔格雷给他自己找...
say:3:1710846003:1.male: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.
say:3:1710846003:1.female: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.

say:4:1710846004:1.text: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.
say:4:1710846004:1.source_cn: 剩下的烂摊子……自有守备军们收拾。
say:4:1710846004:1.male: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.
say:4:1710846004:1.female: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.

say:5:1710846005:1.text: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
say:5:1710846005:1.source_cn: 我就先走一步，找地方补眠去啦！
say:5:1710846005:1.male: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
say:5:1710846005:1.female: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!

choice_prompt:6:1710846005.text: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
choice_prompt:6:1710846005.source_cn: 我就先走一步，找地方补眠去啦！
choice_prompt:6:1710846005.male: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
choice_prompt:6:1710846005.female: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!

say:7:1710846006:1.text: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.
say:7:1710846006:1.source_cn: 你无法接受这突兀的转变。现在的局势依然危急——马克西姆...
say:7:1710846006:1.male: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.
say:7:1710846006:1.female: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.

choice_prompt:8:1710846006.text: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.
choice_prompt:8:1710846006.source_cn: 你无法接受这突兀的转变。现在的局势依然危急——马克西姆国王病重，奥利安王子出逃，王室正统岌岌可危。
choice_prompt:8:1710846006.male: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.
choice_prompt:8:1710846006.female: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.

say:9:1710846007:1.text: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?
say:9:1710846007:1.source_cn: 你终于问出了那个最关键的问题。 是啊，缔造者已经归来，...
say:9:1710846007:1.male: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?
say:9:1710846007:1.female: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?

say:10:1710846008:1.text: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.
say:10:1710846008:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我是罗兰“大帝”没错，但那已经是两千年前的事了。
say:10:1710846008:1.male: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.
say:10:1710846008:1.female: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.

say:11:1710846009:1.text: My era has long since passed.
say:11:1710846009:1.source_cn: 属于罗兰的时代，早就结束了。
say:11:1710846009:1.male: My era has long since passed.
say:11:1710846009:1.female: My era has long since passed.

say:12:1710846010:1.text: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.
say:12:1710846010:1.source_cn: 带领一群流离失所的人，从无到有，在一片荒芜中建立一个新...
say:12:1710846010:1.male: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.
say:12:1710846010:1.female: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.

say:13:1710846011:1.text: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.
say:13:1710846011:1.source_cn: 但是，统治一个已经运行了两千年的、庞大而复杂的国家，那...
say:13:1710846011:1.male: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.
say:13:1710846011:1.female: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.

say:14:1710846012:1.text: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.
say:14:1710846012:1.source_cn: 耀光……早就有它自己的运转逻辑了。
say:14:1710846012:1.male: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.
say:14:1710846012:1.female: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.

say:15:1710846013:1.text: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.
say:15:1710846013:1.source_cn: 梅林，这个世界上，没有人能当“永恒的国王”。就算是我也不行。
say:15:1710846013:1.male: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.
say:15:1710846013:1.female: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.

say:16:1710846014:1.text: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.
say:16:1710846014:1.source_cn: 马克西姆会醒来，或者佩吉会成长……
say:16:1710846014:1.male: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.
say:16:1710846014:1.female: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.

say:17:1710846015:1.text: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.
say:17:1710846015:1.source_cn: 就算他们都不行，这个国家也总会找到自己的办法存续下去。
say:17:1710846015:1.male: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.
say:17:1710846015:1.female: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.

say:18:1710846016:1.text: The path ahead belongs to them.
say:18:1710846016:1.source_cn: 接下来的路，得他们自己走。
say:18:1710846016:1.male: The path ahead belongs to them.
say:18:1710846016:1.female: The path ahead belongs to them.

say:19:1710846017:1.text: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!
say:19:1710846017:1.source_cn: 好了，大道理讲完了。本狐太累了，再不走只能倒头就睡了！
say:19:1710846017:1.male: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!
say:19:1710846017:1.female: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!

narration:21:1710846019:1.text: The little fox's figure vanishes across the plaza, leaving only the echo of his laughter...

choice:8:1:2.text: Why not lead the Empire again?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么不在这时继续统治耀光呢？
choice:8:1:2.male: Why not lead the Empire again?
choice:8:1:2.female: Why not lead the Empire again?
